The allocation request must not use pulse waveform duration as QPU time; atom loading/rearrangement, state preparation, readout, reset and queue/batch overhead dominate the conversion.
Replace the null host timing values with written TGCC/GENCI/Pasqal guidance before quoting requested QPU hours.
